newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar ends unchanged near two-month highs.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar ends unchanged near two-month highs.

text.p: * Canada's dollar ended unchanged on Friday from this
morning's open at a two-month high of C$1.3697 (US$0.7300)
after strong jobs data, traders said.
* They said the currency strengthened after the government reported Canada's unemployment rate fell to 9.1 percent in June from 9.5 percent, its lowest since September 1995.

Statistics Canada noted that the 51,500 rise in employment was accompanied by a decline of about 57,000 in the number of people looking for work, which pushed the unemployment rate down to 9.1 percent.
Full-time employment rose by 93,700 from the month before, while part-time employment fell by 42,200.
In the past four months, about 235,000 full-time jobs were created, Statistics Canada said.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar rose to 83.33 Japanese yen from 82.26 at Thursday's close and strengthened to 1.3005 German marks from 1.2820 marks on Thursday.
